infoLinks.urlText: Bus service improvements in Sydney’s North West from Sunday 30 November
infoLinks.content:
Route 665 Rouse Hill Station to Parramatta will have timetable adjustments, more services:
  • Route 665 (Parramatta to Rouse Hill) will be upgraded to become part of the All Day Frequent Network (ADFN), with services to run every 10 minutes or better during the day and every 20 minutes or better early morning and late evening, seven days a week. Route 665 will also operate 24 hours on Friday and Saturday nights, introducing new overnight services between Parramatta and Rouse Hill.
  • There will be higher capacity buses operating during peak periods to better match passenger demand.
  • Changes to running times to better reflect journey times along the North West T-Way
For more information see the news story.

urlText: Bus service improvements in Sydney’s North West from Sunday 30 November
content:
Route 610X Castle Hill to City QVB (Express Service) will have timetable adjustments and more services:
  • Minor reduction to peak frequency but increased allocation of higher capacity buses to better match passenger demand.
  • Additional trips on weekends to better reflect passenger demand.
For more information see the news story.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus service improvements in Sydney’s North West from Sunday 30 November
infoLinks.content:
Route 620X Dural to City Wynyard via Cherrybrook (Express Service) will have timetable and route adjustments:
  • Route 620X will be shortened to no longer operate between Dural James Henty Drive and Cherrybrook Purchase Rd, due to low patronage.
  • Passengers between James Henty Drive and Purchase Rd can use route 622 and transfer at Cherrybrook (Purchase Rd) or route 635 and transfer for Metro services at Cherrybrook.
For more information see the news story.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus service improvements in Sydney’s North West from Sunday 30 November
infoLinks.content:
Route 614X Baulkham Hills or Winston Hills to City QVB (Express Service) will have timetable changes and route adjustments:
  • Route 614X will no longer operate north of Baulkham Hills (Seven Hills Road near Merindah Road), with every second trip also now starting/ending at Winston Hills Mall.
  • Passengers can use alternative route 660 to connect with M1 Metro services at Norwest Station.
For more information see the news story.
